userPrompt:
Add to src/appsscript.json:

json
"oauthScopes": [
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.external_request",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.scriptapp",
  "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/script.send_mail"
]

The list must be complete, not just the three that failed. script.scriptapp is for ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers/newTrigger — you'll need it for the trigger refactor. script.send_mail for MailApp, which test_send touches even under DRY_RUN. PropertiesService needs no scope. Add userinfo.email only if anything calls Session.getActiveUser().

Then, in order — the re-auth step is the one people skip:

npm run push:dev
